components.name: Pipeline Flow
components.description: Signature mechanism diagram; states shown by luminance: lit, blocked (tagged on the draft), dimmed, and the inverted human node. On the home hero it has two labelled zones, The system and Me, the second a full-size real deal path (seller first; the system rows are compact) ending with only Live in production Chalk-filled. Below 768px the system zone wraps into a row of chips. The draft gate keeps a "1 stopped" record tag once the first draft is stopped.

components.css: .ds-flow { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-flow li { display: grid; gap: 2px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #313131); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, #1F1F1F); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text, #EDEDED); transition: background-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), opacity 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-flow li span { font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted, #9B9B9B); } .ds-flow li:hover { border-color: var(--muted, #9B9B9B); } .ds-flow li.human { background: var(--text, #EDEDED); color: var(--bg, #181818); border-color: var(--text, #EDEDED); } .ds-flow li.lit { border-color: var(--muted, #9B9B9B); background: var(--surface-2, #272727); } .ds-flow li.blocked { border-color: var(--text, #EDEDED); background: var(--bg, #181818); position: relative; } .ds-flow li.blocked::after { content: "draft stopped"; position: absolute; right: 8px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; background: var(--text, #EDEDED); color: var(--bg, #181818); } .ds-flow li.dim { opacity: 0.35; }

narrative.overview:
The site behaves like the systems it describes. A pipeline lights node by node, a gate stops a draft, a terminal prints a priced batch and then refuses one over the cap. Everything around those mechanisms is quiet chrome: graphite surfaces, hairline borders, grey type that brightens only where attention belongs. The visitor should feel they are looking at working equipment, not a brochure about it.

Density is moderate and editorial: one wide column (max 1200px) with generous vertical gaps (64px between home sections), readable measures (about 72 characters a line, --measure: 52ch) for prose, and numbers set large on hairlines rather than in boxes. Emphasis comes from brightness, not hue. Today the palette has no accent colour; that is the current state, not a permanent rule, and a single accent may be introduced later if it earns its place.

Motion is functional storytelling, never decoration. Entrances are short blur-and-rise appearances; the live diagrams run on clocks that pause off screen; every effect has a still, complete fallback for reduced motion, no JavaScript, and print.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome graphite ladder, emphasis by luminance
Geist for everything, Geist Mono for metadata and machine output
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines; no shadows
Small, consistent radii (8px controls, 12px containers, 16px media)
Live mechanism diagrams as the signature element
Every animated state has a static equivalent

rules.name: The Luminance Rule
rules.body: State is shown by brightness, borders, tags and motion: lit is Graphite Lifted with an Ash border, unreached steps drop to Smoke text while a draft runs, current is a Chalk border, blocked is a Chalk border on Graphite with an inverted mono tag ("draft stopped") on the draft rather than a strike through the gate, the human node lit means ready ("draft ready"), skipped steps dim to 35% opacity. The pinned case-study flow still pulses a White ring on its final step.

rules.name: The Tokens-Only Rule
rules.body: Colours live once in `:root` and are referenced by variable; no literal colour values in rules; translucency is mixed from a token (`color-mix`), never written as a raw `rgba()`.

rules.name: The Machine Voice Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono marks metadata and machine output only (dates, kickers, terminal, examples). Headings and prose never go mono.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. Hover is a one-step tonal change or a 1.03 media zoom inside a clipped frame, never a shadow or a translate.

dos: **Do** express state through luminance, borders, tags, opacity and motion (see The Luminance Rule).
**Do** keep every interactive target at least 44px tall, extending text links with an invisible hit area rather than restyling them.
**Do** give every animation a still, complete end state for reduced motion, no JavaScript, and print.
**Do** run looping diagrams only while on screen, and label illustrations that are not real data.
**Do** set numbers in tabular figures on a top hairline, with their definition beneath in Smoke.
**Do** frame every image and video in a 1px Hairline border with the radius ladder (8 / 12 / 16px).
donts: **Don't** add box shadows, glows or lifted hover states; the system is flat.
**Don't** use colour to signal errors or success (no red, no green); errors are a doubled Chalk edge plus a Mono-small Chalk message.
**Don't** set headings or prose in Geist Mono; mono is for metadata and machine output.
**Don't** write literal colours in rules; add a token to `:root`.
**Don't** box the stat figures; they sit on hairlines.
**Don't** use more than one inverted Chalk button per view.
